mechanism: Isoniazid inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing albendazole metabolism through CYP3A4, while isoniazid itself may have altered metabolism; both drugs have hepatotoxic potential.
action: Monitor liver function tests (AST/ALT) regularly; consider alternative anthelmintic if hepatic impairment present; counsel patient on hepatotoxicity symptoms.
